title: Near-infrared luminescence from Li2ZnGeO4:Ln3+ (Ln = Er, Tm, Ho)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8784-8794
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07999J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nikola Bednarska-Adam, Marta Kuwik, Tomasz Goryczka, Vitalii Ivanov, Józef Dresner, Wojciech A. Pisarski, Joanna Pisarska
Enhanced NIR emission due to characteristic transitions of Ln3+ ions in Li2ZnGeO4 is observed. Decay curve analysis indicates that the emission from the excited states of Ln3+ ions in Li2ZnGeO4 is long-lived.
